*Metaplanet* shares fell nearly 10% in Japan on Tuesday, extending a two-session slide of about 17% after a public note from CEO *Simon Gerovich* failed to calm investors.

* The issue relates to the firm's Series 10 option pool, which grew from about 46 million shares to 319 million because it was adjusted to remain equal to 20% of fully diluted shares rather than a fixed number.
* The structure allowed the executive award pool to grow while existing shareholders were diluted as Metaplanet continued to issue stock to buy *bitcoin*.
* Gerovich admitted Metaplanet "had not done a good enough job" communicating the company's plans and structure with shareholders, noting it froze the pool in August and added a five-year lock-up.

78767.subject: Tokenization Briefing: Tokenized Treasuries Grew 75% in 2026
78767.body:
The Tokenization Briefing newsletter keeps you up to date with market insights and visual analyses on what matters in the world of tokenized assets

( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters )

GM and welcome to the first issue of Tokenization Briefing, The Block Research's weekly read on tokenized assets. Every Tuesday morning we'll bring you the data and charts behind the migration of real-world assets onto blockchain rails, along with the analysis to make sense of it.

We're starting in a busy month. ICE, the London Stock Exchange and Robinhood all announced tokenized equity initiatives in the past four weeks, and they did it in a segment that barely existed a year ago.

In today's issue, we look at Robinhood Chain two months after mainnet, where tokenized equities now account for three-quarters of tokenized value and stock tokens have found an unexpected market as memecoin quote assets. We also cover tokenized Treasuries reaching $15.9 billion, with traditional asset managers rather than crypto-native issuers driving the gains, and what ICE's agreement with tZERO means for tokenized assets as clearing house collateral.

Thanks for subscribing!

*Top of Mind*

*Tokenized equities represent three-quarters of Robinhood Chain's tokenized value*

Robinhood Chain launched mainnet on July 1, 2026, and has shown impressive growth in every tracked metric since.

Tokenized equities are a part of that growth story. The platform rolled out with roughly 95 Stock Tokens available across more than 120 countries, with tokenized equities meant to be the anchor product on the network. The catalog has since grown to over 190 Stock Tokens while total value tokenized on the network rose from $11.9 million on July 1 to $149.4 million on September 4.

Tokenized equities have accounted for at least 75% of tokenized value since launch and stood at 77.1% on September 4, or roughly $115.1 million of the $149.4 million total. ETFs are the only category to have gained meaningful ground, roughly doubling their share since the end of July to 15.3%.

Each Stock Token is a standard ERC-20 issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited as a tokenized debt security, providing economic exposure to an underlying US share or ETF without conferring any legal or beneficial rights in it. Structuring Stock Tokens as ERC-20 gives these assets instant composability, allowing them to plug into lending protocols, liquidity pools, and yield strategies across the ecosystem. Pool-level data shows the memecoin market taking up a meaningful share of that liquidity.

A September 1 read of pool reserves by DeFiPrime identified 432 liquidity pools using a Stock Token as the quote asset for a memecoin, holding 17.2% of the onchain float across the 19 tickers it examined and carrying 31.3% of their 24-hour trading volume, with both figures stated as lower bounds. 78761.subject: Ownership Coins Go EVM
78761.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

Hey all, happy Tuesday! Today we assess how Robinhood Chain’s licensing fees are reshaping Arbitrum revenue, and examine Umia’s bid to bring ownership coins beyond Solana and onto the EVM after its $6.1M token sale. Let’s get into it!

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

BTC closed Monday down 1.7%, drifting from just above $80,000 to hold near $79,000 in thin holiday liquidity. With US cash equities closed and commodity futures on shortened Labor Day hours, their Hyperliquid (HIP3) markets traded essentially flat (Nasdaq 100 +0.1%, S&P 500 -0.1%, gold flat, WTI +0.3%). 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/23015518-cde7-4148-bfcf-e53cf89fc373/image.png?t=1788865100)
Caption: 

The macro backdrop remains the same one that sent markets across the board lower into the long weekend. Friday's August jobs report came in at 162K against a 56K consensus, with upward revisions to June and July figures. Bitcoin dropped slightly over 3% in the hours following the release on Friday and continued to trade weakly into the weekend and on Monday.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a1d4b2ba-160f-4636-9051-e1580b8ca0e3/image.png?t=1788865100)
Caption: 

In terms of sectors, Monday was broadly red. The only indices to finish higher were the L2 index (+4.1%), Gaming (+2.2%), and Meme (+1.7%), with DePIN roughly flat. The worst performers were the Privacy index (-6.5%), DEXs (-5.3%), Solana Eco (-3.9%), Oracle (-3.8%), and Ethereum Eco (-3.7%).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/52998c31-4fcf-4e40-8284-ac1cebc71ee2/image.png?t=1788865100)
Caption: 

The Privacy index decline is best read as mean reversion after a parabolic stretch rather than a change in trend. Zcash (ZEC) came into Monday up roughly 45% on the week and 134% on the month, having reclaimed $1,000 for the first time in nearly a decade. Even after Monday's pullback, privacy remains the only major sector trading above its October 2025 levels.

The L2 index was the clearest counter-trend bid, extending a run that carried it nearly 12% higher across the holiday weekend while the Ethereum Eco index finished Monday down 3.7%. ARB continues to be the best performer in the L2 index, following Robinhood Chain’s continued success.
